settings.title: Settings
settings.general.language_desc: Choose the language used throughout the application.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.hero_desc: Solo dev, night coder, tool maker. Currently building Photonic and other stuff at ThePhoenixFactory. I believe software should be simple, fast, and stay out of your way. When I'm not coding, I'm probably riding rollercoasters or creating new artwork.
scan.running_next: Scan already running — folder will be included next time

collection_dialog.select_to_remove: Select a collection to remove from the selected items:
settings.app.desc: Media library manager. Organize, tag, and browse your photo and video collection with powerful filtering and cleaning tools.
settings.updates.title: Updates
settings.updates.desc: Photonic checks GitHub for new releases at startup.
settings.general.title: General
settings.general.confirm_delete_desc: Show a confirmation dialog before deleting items, tags, collections, or folders.
settings.general.show_extensions_desc: Display file extensions (e.g. .jpg, .png) in the photo grid.
settings.general.show_hidden_default_des: Display hidden photos in the library by default instead of excluding them.
settings.general.telemetry_desc: Send an anonymous launch ping (app version and OS only). Never any photo or personal data.
settings.display.title: Display
settings.display.thumb_desc: Adjust the size of photo thumbnails in the grid.
settings.display.default_view_desc: Choose the default layout when browsing your items.
settings.display.default_view_masonry: Masonry is a beta feature and may still have layout glitches.
settings.display.cluster_desc: On the Locations map, photos are grouped into clusters only where at least this many photos sit close together; anywhere else they render as individual markers.
settings.display.cluster_1: Set it to 1 to group from 2 photos at the same spot.
settings.display.cluster_global_desc: Clustering is enabled only once the map holds more than this many geo-tagged photos. Below it, no grouping happens at all and every photo shows as an individual marker.
settings.display.cluster_global_ex: Ex. at 700: 701 photos on the map → clustering active; 699 photos → fully deactivated.
settings.display.cluster_warn: Warning: large cluster groups may impact map fluidity.
settings.display.cluster_global_warn: Warning: very high values may impact map fluidity.
settings.display.palettes_desc: Pick a ready-made color scheme, or fine-tune every color below.
settings.display.bg_primary_desc: Main app background and header gradient start.
settings.display.bg_secondary_desc: Panels, cards, menus and header gradient middle.
settings.display.bg_tertiary_desc: Inputs, hover states and header gradient end.
settings.display.accent_desc: Highlights, active states, buttons and focus rings.
settings.display.borders_desc: Card outlines, separators and input borders.
settings.display.reset_colors_desc: Restore the default Photonic dark theme.
settings.data.title: Data
settings.data.rescan_desc: Re-scan all folders to pick up new or changed items.
settings.tags.desc: Manage tags used to organize your library. Edit names and colors inline.
settings.tags.delete_msg: Delete tag "{name}"? Items will keep their other tags.
settings.collections.desc: Organize items into collections with nested hierarchy, custom icons, and colors.
settings.collections.delete_msg: Delete collection "{name}"? Items will be removed from this collection, and sub-collections might be affected.
settings.folders.desc: Manage the folders that Photonic scans for media. Removing a folder keeps its items in the library.
settings.folders.remove_msg: Remove folder "{path}"? Items in this folder will remain in the library.
update.view_release_toast: New version {v} available — view release
